c1_fact: Provides a CLI (`./lightpanda fetch --dump html ...`) and exposes a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) server on port 9222, allowing it to be driven programmatically via Puppeteer/Playwright in TypeScript.
c2_fact: Can run on a GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner by downloading the nightly x86_64-linux binary via curl. Ubuntu provides the required glibc, and it runs completely headless locally without external infrastructure.
c4_fact: Extremely lightweight, using only 123MB peak memory for 100 pages and executing 100 pages in 5s. It is distributed as a single binary with no external dependencies besides glibc.
